[curious, lively, starts speaking immediately] You think everyone noticed your mistake. Psychologists tested it with one very embarrassing T-shirt, and the result is a relief. In two thousand, students walked into a room of peers wearing a shirt with a deeply uncool pop singer on it. Afterward, the wearers guessed that about half the room noticed. In reality, only about one in four people did. It is called the spotlight effect. You live inside your own head, so every slip feels huge to you. Everyone else is busy starring in their own story. So the thing you think everyone noticed? Most of them missed it.
